utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What time does the repair drive start?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I think it starts at 9 this morning.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, I’ll head over around 9.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Noah. I’ve got a few tools I can lend for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Gus. I can probably use one of those tools — I’ll take a look and grab the right one.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, take your time and grab whatever fits the job best. I’ll be here if you need a hand.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive's getting a good bit of help today. Folks around here do show up when it counts.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Mhm, and I hear they’re already lining up supplies. If the weather holds, they might get a whole lot done.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure, I can help with that repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, where should I bring it?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Bring it by my porch around three; I’ll be there to take a look.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely, I’m telling folks about it now. Come by if you can lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can stop by for a bit. Just tell me where you need me.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, thanks. The kitchen table could use a hand first, then we’ll see if we can get to the porch hinge.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Leo, I’ve got the repair drive notes ready and can help organize the next steps.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, send me the notes and I’ll help sort the next steps.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, I’ll send them over now and we can divide up the tasks.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Can you remind me what needs to be repaired on the drive?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: It needs the potholes patched, the cracks filled, and the loose gravel cleared off.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it, so it’s the potholes, cracks, and loose gravel. I’ll keep that straight.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help with that after drop-off if the timing works, but this week is tight with school pickup.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can take the first shift after drop-off if that helps, and I’ll keep it to what fits around pickup.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That helps a lot. I can do the second shift after pickup if you can hand off the first one.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard there was a repair drive, but I only got that second-hand. What’s the latest on it?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I heard it’s moving along; folks have started dropping off repairs and the list is being sorted now.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Good to know. I’m curious who’s got the next batch on the list.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I can help with that. What’s left on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: What’s still left on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’m not sure offhand, but I can check what’s left.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with that. What still needs fixing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Mostly the shelf by the garage, and maybe the loose step on the porch. I might be forgetting one thing, though.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That sounds like the main list. Tell me if you remember the other thing, and we can add it.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’m on the repair drive list. I’ll tell the others and make sure it gets sorted.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Good, then let me know what’s still needed and I’ll keep track of it.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely, I’ll keep track and let you know what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard the repair drive is moving along. I can swing by later and see what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, that’d help. I can fill you in on what’s still open when you get here.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good, I’ll stop by and check what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Hey Vik, I might be a bit fuzzy on the details, but I’m here and ready to help with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’m in. Let’s keep it simple and line up what needs fixing, then we can start working through it together.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sounds good, let’s start with the easiest fixes and work down the list together.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, the repair drive. I think I heard about that, but I might’ve missed the latest change.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I think the latest change is that it starts tomorrow instead of today.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it, tomorrow then. Thanks for catching me up.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can lend you my drill and a couple clamps if that helps get the repair drive moving.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That'd help a lot, Gus. I'll get the drive set up and use the drill and clamps carefully.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, thanks — I’ll be over if you need a hand tightening anything up.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can help with that repair drive. Just tell me where you need me and what to bring.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, Mara. Could you bring a screwdriver set, some spare screws, and your phone flashlight? I’ll send the address now.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely, I’ll bring those over and keep an eye out for your address.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can ask around and see who’s free to help with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, could you check whether the community center or the tool shed is available?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’ll check both and let you know which one’s open.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks for checking in, Cleo. I’ve got the repair drive list organized, and I can slot in any last-minute fixes if you send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Rosa. I’ll check the stock and send over anything missing right away.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, send me the list and I’ll fold it into the drive plan right away.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard there’s a repair drive happening, but I only know that second-hand. Is Mina the one coordinating it?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yeah, I’m coordinating it. What do you need fixed?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: It’s just my porch light and the kitchen sink that need work, if you’re still taking things on.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Could you help with the morning drop-off and pick-up while I’m at the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can help with that. Tell me what still needs fixing, and I’ll take a look.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, you’re saying you can handle the repairs if I tell you what’s still broken?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, that’s right. Tell me what’s broken and I’ll handle the repairs.
